title: Comment "Remove" and I'll send you the full setup guide 👇 Claude has started leaving watermarks on
description: Comment "Remove" and I'll send you the full setup guide 👇 Claude has started leaving watermarks on everything it creates, and they're designed to be impossible to remove. Anthropic just announced that every piece of text Claude generates now has an invisible watermark. It even survives when you copy and paste it somewhere else. But there's a secret way to remove it. Here's how: Google "Watermarks Remover GitHub skill" and copy the URL Go to Claude → Code → paste it in → say "Install this skill" Start a new chat and type "/remove ai marks" Paste in your text The output comes back completely clean so you can copy and paste it anywhere. #ai #claude #claudeskills #aitools #watermark
